result_summary.title: Deploy Manager memory spikes and rate limits in US-West Dev
result_summary.description: We're seeing high memory usage on the Deploy Manager instances in our US-West development environment. Autoscaling isn't kicking in to handle the load, and we are hitting rate limit exceeded errors. This is definitely an insufficient capacity planning issue on our end, or perhaps the environment wasn't sized correctly during the last deploy. We need more resources allocated to handle the current traffic.

final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The investigation suggests that insufficient capacity planning is the root cause of the high memory usage and rate limit exceeded errors on the Deploy Manager instances in the US-West development environment. The evidence from telemetry, technical signals, and recent changes supports this hypothesis. It is recommended to increase capacity allocation and review autoscaling configuration to handle high memory usage.
